name: Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: From central Bogura, travel toward Silimpur through the Medical College Road area. CNG, auto-rickshaw, local transport and private vehicles are available. The college and its hospital are located in the Silimpur area.
description: Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College is one of the most important government medical education and healthcare institutions in northern Bangladesh. It is located in Silimpur, Bogura Sadar and operates alongside Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital. According to the Directorate General of Health Services facility registry, the medical college hospital was established in 2006. The institution combines medical education, clinical training, patient care and medical research. Students receive practical training through hospital-based clinical departments while patients from Bogura and surrounding districts receive a wide range of healthcare services. The hospital functions as an important referral centre for the region and contributes significantly to emergency and specialized healthcare. The institution is also important for developing doctors and other healthcare professionals who later serve throughout Bangladesh. Its location in Bogura Sadar makes it one of the district's most recognizable public healthcare landmarks. For a district information portal, this institution should be presented not merely as a hospital but as a major centre of medical education, healthcare delivery and professional development. The official DGHS registry lists its location in Silimpur and provides the institution's official contact information.

name: TMSS Medical College
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: From central Bogura, take Rangpur Road toward Thengamara. CNG, auto-rickshaw, bus and private vehicles can be used. The campus is located beside the Dhaka-Rangpur Highway.
description: TMSS Medical College is a major private-sector medical education and healthcare institution in Bogura. It is situated in the Thengamara area beside Rangpur Road and is part of the broader TMSS educational and healthcare network. The institution provides medical education and practical clinical training while its associated healthcare facilities provide treatment services to patients from Bogura and surrounding districts. TMSS also operates related educational programs in dental care, nursing and medical technology, creating a broader health-education ecosystem. The institution's importance goes beyond classroom education because students receive practical exposure through clinical services. The TMSS network has developed multiple programs intended to produce doctors, nurses, dental professionals and medical technologists. This makes it an important contributor to the healthcare workforce of northern Bangladesh. For a district portal, TMSS Medical College can be categorized under medical institutions, educational institutions and healthcare facilities. It is particularly useful to include because visitors and residents may search for both education and healthcare information from the same database.

name: Rural Development Academy
boguraSadarDistance: Approximately 15-20 km south of Bogura city
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel south from Bogura city toward Sherpur using the Dhaka-Bogura Highway. From the Sherpur area, follow local road directions to the RDA campus. CNG, bus and private vehicles are commonly used.
description: The Rural Development Academy, commonly known as RDA Bogura, is one of Bangladesh's most important institutions for rural development research, training and experimentation. The academy works on practical development problems affecting rural communities and supports government officials, development practitioners, farmers and other stakeholders through training and research. Its activities cover areas such as agriculture, rural economy, local institutions, poverty reduction, water management, technology adoption, human resource development and community-based development. RDA is particularly significant because it does not function only as a conventional educational institution. It also serves as a testing ground for development ideas and technologies before wider application. Training programs help government and development-sector personnel improve their knowledge and practical skills. Research projects generate evidence that can contribute to rural development policy and planning. The academy has become one of Bogura's best-known national institutions and is frequently associated with agricultural innovation and rural development. For Discover Bogura, RDA should be listed as a major government research, training and development institution because its national role makes it much more significant than an ordinary local office.

name: Spices Research Centre, BARI
location: Spices Research Centre, Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute, Shibganj, Bogura-5810
boguraSadarDistance: Approximately 17 km north of Bogura city
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel north from Bogura city toward Shibganj and Mahasthangarh. The research centre is located in the Shibganj agricultural research area. CNG, local transport and private vehicles can be used.
description: The Spices Research Centre of Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute is a specialized agricultural research institution located in Shibganj, Bogura. The centre was established in November 1996 with the goal of increasing domestic spice production and reducing dependence on imports. Its research focuses on important spice crops and related production technologies. Researchers conduct variety evaluation, adaptive trials, production technology development, disease and pest management studies and other experiments designed to improve productivity and profitability. The centre also contributes to seed and planting-material production and dissemination and supports farmers through demonstrations, training and technology transfer. According to its annual research documentation, the centre covers a substantial research area and works within agro-ecological conditions representative of northern Bangladesh. Its location near Mahasthangarh also makes it geographically significant for a Bogura tourism and knowledge portal because visitors can connect agricultural research with the district's historical heritage. The institution is one of the clearest examples of Bogura's importance not only in history and culture but also in modern agricultural science.

name: Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute, Bogura
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel toward the Sheujgari-Carmichael Road area of Bogura city. CNG, rickshaw, auto-rickshaw and private vehicles are available.
description: The Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute has important research activities and facilities in Bogura and contributes to the agricultural development of northern Bangladesh. Research activities associated with the Bogura area cover crop production, improved varieties, agricultural technologies and field-level testing. These institutions support farmers by generating practical solutions suitable for local agro-ecological conditions. Agricultural research is especially important in Bogura because the district has a large rural economy and is known for diversified crop production. Research centres and regional facilities help bridge the gap between laboratory or experimental research and farmers' fields. Researchers evaluate varieties, production methods and technologies and then support dissemination through demonstrations, training and extension activities. The Bogura facilities are therefore valuable for both agriculture and the wider regional economy. For a district portal, BARI should be categorized as a research institution rather than simply an office because its primary contribution is scientific agricultural research and technology development.

name: Bangladesh Sericulture Research and Training Institute
banglaName: বাংলাদেশ রেশম গবেষণা ও প্রশিক্ষণ ইনস্টিটিউট
boguraSadarDistance: Outside Bogura district; approximately 100+ km from Bogura city
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel west from Bogura toward Rajshahi by road. The institute is located in Rajshahi city, not in Bogura district.
description: The Bangladesh Sericulture Research and Training Institute is an important national institution for Bangladesh's silk sector, but it should not be stored as a Bogura-located institution. The institute was originally established in Rajshahi in 1962 as the Silk cum Lac Research Institute and Silk Technological Institute. After the Bangladesh Sericulture Board was established in 1978, the institution was renamed the Bangladesh Sericulture Research and Training Institute. Its work includes developing improved mulberry varieties, improving leaf nutritional quality, developing sustainable mulberry cultivation technologies, improving silkworm breeds for higher cocoon productivity and silk content, and researching mechanization and alternative uses of mulberry. It also provides technical knowledge and training related to sericulture. Because the institute is in Rajshahi rather than Bogura, it should either be placed in a separate regional institutions collection or stored with district='Rajshahi'. Including it in a Bogura collection without marking the correct district would make your database geographically inaccurate.
dataNote: Important national institution, but not located in Bogura district.

name: Army Medical College Bogura
boguraSadarDistance: Approximately 10-12 km south of Bogura city
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel south from Bogura city along the Dhaka-Bogura Highway toward Majhira Cantonment. Public road transport, CNG and private vehicles can reach the cantonment area. Access to military facilities is controlled.
description: Army Medical College Bogura is a military medical education institution located within Majhira Cantonment in Shajahanpur. It was established in 2014 and is affiliated with Bangladesh University of Professionals. The college provides medical education and professional training with an emphasis on disciplined, high-quality medical practice. Students receive academic instruction alongside practical clinical exposure. The institution contributes to the development of medical professionals for the Armed Forces and the broader healthcare system. Its location within Bogura Cantonment places it within one of the district's most important military and institutional zones. Because the campus is located inside a military cantonment, public access and photography may be subject to military regulations. A public tourism or district-information database should therefore provide only general location and institutional information and should not include sensitive security or operational details. For Discover Bogura, it is best categorized as a military educational institution rather than a tourist attraction.

name: Bogura Cantonment
boguraSadarDistance: Approximately 10 km south of Bogura city
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel south from Bogura city along the Dhaka-Bogura Highway toward Majhira. The cantonment is accessible through the surrounding public road network, but entry into military facilities is controlled.
description: Bogura Cantonment, also known as Majhira Cantonment, is one of the major military establishments in northern Bangladesh. It is located in Shajahanpur, approximately 10 kilometres south of Bogura city. The cantonment is associated with the headquarters of the 11th Infantry Division and contains important military training and educational institutions. The Armoured Corps Centre and School and the Non-Commissioned Officers Academy are among the publicly documented institutions associated with the cantonment. Army Medical College Bogura is also located within the cantonment area. The cantonment therefore functions as a major centre for military administration, training, professional development and support services. It has substantial importance for Bogura's institutional landscape, although it is not a conventional tourist destination. Public visitors should follow cantonment rules and should not attempt to enter restricted areas without authorization. For your database, the safest and most useful approach is to describe the cantonment at a high institutional level without storing sensitive information such as unit deployment, security arrangements, weapons, operational schedules or restricted facility locations.
securityNote: Do not expose operational or security-sensitive information in public API responses.

name: Jahangirabad Cantonment
boguraSadarDistance: Approximately 35-40 km northwest of Bogura city
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel northwest from Bogura city toward Adamdighi through the regional road network. From Adamdighi, follow local directions toward Jahangirabad. Entry into military areas is controlled.
description: Jahangirabad Cantonment is a military establishment in Bogura district and forms part of the Bangladesh Army's institutional presence in the northern region. It is located in the Adamdighi area and is geographically separate from Majhira Cantonment. The cantonment supports military administration, training and defence-related activities. Because cantonments are controlled military environments, they should not be treated as ordinary tourist attractions even though they may contain educational and institutional facilities. For a district portal, the appropriate information is its general location, institutional identity and broad role. Visitors should use public roads around the area and follow all military access restrictions. No operational details, security layouts or sensitive military information should be included in a public-facing database.

name: Bogura Airfield
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: Travel through Bogura Sadar toward the Bogura Airfield area. Access to operational aviation facilities is controlled and visitors should follow CAAB and security instructions.
description: Bogura Airfield is an important aviation facility in the district and is currently associated with Bangladesh Air Force training activities. In 2026, the government announced plans to upgrade the airfield into an international-standard airport and develop a modern flying academy. The government has also announced plans for a new Bangladesh Air Force base in the northern region. These developments could significantly increase Bogura's importance as an aviation and economic centre. The Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh's aeronautical information publication lists the airfield and its aviation infrastructure, confirming that it is an established aerodrome rather than merely a proposed site. Because aviation facilities have security and operational restrictions, a public database should provide general information only. It should not publish restricted runway operations, military schedules or security-sensitive infrastructure. For Discover Bogura, this should be classified as an aviation and strategic infrastructure location, with a status field distinguishing the existing airfield from future development projects.
status: Existing airfield; major upgrade and development plans announced in 2026

description: In 2026, the government announced plans for a new Bangladesh Air Force base in Bogura as part of a broader aviation-development initiative. The proposal is linked to the existing Bogura Airfield, which is also planned for upgrading toward international standards. Public statements described the proposed base as the first Bangladesh Air Force base in the northern region. The initiative is intended to strengthen aviation and air-defence capabilities while also supporting regional development. The government has separately discussed establishing a flying academy in the area to develop civilian pilot skills. Because this is a defence infrastructure project, it should be represented in a public database as a proposed or developing institution rather than as an ordinary tourist attraction. name: Bogura University
location: Bogura district; permanent campus development to be determined
boguraSadarDistance: Temporary administrative/academic arrangements have been associated with Bogura city area
howToGoFromBoguraSadar: The exact permanent campus route should be updated after the government officially finalizes the campus location. For current administrative activities, use the university's officially announced temporary campus address.
description: Bogura's public university project has undergone an important change in 2026. Earlier plans focused on Bogura Science and Technology University, and the UGC had approved two departments—Computer Science and Engineering and Automobile Engineering—in January 2026. However, Parliament passed the Bogura University Bill 2026 on 14 July 2026, replacing the earlier Science and Technology University framework with a full-fledged public university concept. The new university is intended to provide broader education and research across science, life sciences, engineering, technology, arts, social sciences, business administration, law, agriculture, medical sciences and emerging fields. This makes the institution strategically important for Bogura's future education, research and innovation ecosystem. Since the transition is recent, your database should not describe the university as having a fully operational permanent campus unless that is confirmed by the university or government. Instead, use status fields such as 'established by law', 'academic preparation ongoing' and 'permanent campus pending/under development' where appropriate. This will prevent your website from displaying outdated information about the former BSTU concept.
status: Public university established through Bogura University Bill 2026; implementation and campus development ongoing
previousLegalFramework: Bogura Science and Technology University Act, 2001
